content.title: Samsung SDI unit signs US battery deal worth over $1.36 billion for energy storage systems
content.summary: South Korea's Samsung SDI said on Wednesday that its unit Samsung SDI ​America has signed a deal to supply lithium ‌iron phosphate (LFP) batteries to a U.S. customer for energy storage systems, triggering ‌a sharp rally in its shares.  Samsung ‌SDI did not name the customer, describing it as an energy infrastructure development and ‍operations company.  The announcement sent Samsung SDI shares up as much as 6.1% in morning trade, versus the benchmark KOSPI's 0.1% fall.
